maintenance_led.reason: Mainly sells new wafer cleaning, plating, and polishing tools to chipmakers; service is a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private and state-linked semiconductor fabs buying wafer processing equipment; not government-paid contracts.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own proprietary tools (SAPS, TEBO, Ultra ECP) and expanding products, not by roll-up acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Tools are qualified into customers' fab process flows; switching needs re-qualification and risks yield and downtime.
